## Checklist

- [ ] The build, `pnpm -r typecheck` and the behavior tests pass (house-style
      checks may stay red; see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] A new config key is classified in `os-code/src/config/projectPolicy.ts`
      (skip if none)
- [ ] A new network call has an entry in `app/src/lib/egressManifest.ts`
      (skip if none)
- [ ] I have signed the CLA (the bot will ask on your first pull request)

Polish, wording and design are snapped to the brand by a maintainer when the
change is pulled in, so a working change with a test is enough.
